caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #42: FORTUITOUS

fortuitous (adjective): happening by chance, often luckily.

✅ In a sentence: A fortuitous meeting on a train led to their business partnership.
✅ Similar: accidental, lucky, serendipitous
✅ Remember it: Strictly means "by chance," not just "lucky."
